acceptanceCriteria: finish-lane validates the verify file before prepare and refuses early with the same code.
Test covers a quoted -run regex line.
body: Observed 2026-10-17 in lane gh-pool (PR #1061): finish-lane prepare PASSED, then bind refused the verify file with unsupported-verify-syntax (a quoted -run regex), so the attempt made no commits and cost a full prepare. Expected: verify-file syntax is validated before prepare.
title: dogfood finish-lane checks verify-file syntax only at bind, after prepare already passed
